canonical_topic: Monte Carlo analysis as a valuation tool
definition: Monte Carlo analysis uses statistical simulation to solve mathematical problems that are difficult to solve directly with algebra or calculus.
core_idea: It is one of the primary techniques used to value complicated investments when a closed-form (algebraic/calculus-based) solution isn't practical.
key_points: Monte Carlo analysis applies statistics/simulation rather than closed-form math.
It is a primary method for valuing complex investments.
relationships: Built on the same statistical foundation as volatility and correlation.
trading_implications: Used when investments are too complicated to value with straightforward algebraic or calculus-based formulas.
